mapper.sql: SELECT p.id, 'POST' AS document_type, p.title, p.content, u.display_name AS author_name, u.avatar_url, NULL AS source_url, pet.pet_type, NULL AS category, NULL AS trust_level, p.published_at, CONCAT('/app/community?post=', p.id) AS route_path FROM community_post p JOIN app_user u ON u.id = p.author_id AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN pet_profile pet ON pet.id = p.pet_profile_id WHERE p.status = 'PUBLISHED' UNION ALL SELECT d.id, 'KNOWLEDGE' AS document_type, d.title, d.content, COALESCE(d.source_author, d.source_name) AS author_name, NULL AS avatar_url, d.source_url, d.pet_type, d.category, d.trust_level, d.published_at, CONCAT('/app/chat?source=', d.id) AS route_path FROM knowledge_document d WHERE d.status = 'READY' AND d.review_status = 'APPROVED' AND d.consent_status != 'WITHDRAWN' AND (d.expires_at IS NULL OR d.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) UNION ALL SELECT u.id, 'USER' AS document_type, u.display_name AS title, COALESCE(u.bio, '') AS content, CONCAT('@', u.username) AS author_name, u.avatar_url, NULL AS source_url, NULL AS pet_type, NULL AS category, NULL AS trust_level, u.created_at AS published_at, CONCAT('/app/users/', u.id) AS route_path FROM app_user u WHERE u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.role IN ('USER', 'VERIFIED_SELLER') UNION ALL SELECT t.id, 'TOPIC' AS document_type, t.name AS title, COALESCE(t.description, '') AS content, '社区话题' AS author_name, NULL AS avatar_url, NULL AS source_url, NULL AS pet_type, NULL AS category, NULL AS trust_level, t.created_at AS published_at, CONCAT('/app/community?topic=', t.id) AS route_path FROM community_topic t WHERE t.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select:
SELECT source.* FROM () source
ORDER BY source.published_at DESC
ORDER BY (source.title = #{keyword}) DESC, (source.title LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%')) DESC, source.published_at DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT candidate FROM ( SELECT p.title AS candidate FROM community_post p WHERE p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.title LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') UNION SELECT d.title FROM knowledge_document d WHERE d.status = 'READY' AND d.review_status = 'APPROVED' AND d.consent_status != 'WITHDRAWN' AND (d.expires_at IS NULL OR d.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) AND d.title LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') UNION SELECT u.display_name FROM app_user u WHERE u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.role IN ('USER', 'VERIFIED_SELLER') AND u.display_name LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') UNION SELECT t.name FROM community_topic t WHERE t.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.name LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') ) suggestions ORDER BY CHAR_LENGTH(candidate), candidate LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.id, 'POST' AS document_type, p.title, p.content, u.display_name AS author_name, u.avatar_url, NULL AS source_url, pet.pet_type, NULL AS category, NULL AS trust_level, p.published_at, CONCAT('/app/community?post=', p.id) AS route_path FROM community_post p JOIN app_user u ON u.id = p.author_id AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN pet_profile pet ON pet.id = p.pet_profile_id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED'

SELECT d.id, 'KNOWLEDGE' AS document_type, d.title, d.content, COALESCE(d.source_author, d.source_name) AS author_name, NULL AS avatar_url, d.source_url, d.pet_type, d.category, d.trust_level, d.published_at, CONCAT('/app/chat?source=', d.id) AS route_path FROM knowledge_document d WHERE d.id = #{id} AND d.status = 'READY' AND d.review_status = 'APPROVED' AND d.consent_status != 'WITHDRAWN' AND (d.expires_at IS NULL OR d.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))

SELECT u.id, 'USER' AS document_type, u.display_name AS title, COALESCE(u.bio, '') AS content, CONCAT('@', u.username) AS author_name, u.avatar_url, NULL AS source_url, NULL AS pet_type, NULL AS category, NULL AS trust_level, u.created_at AS published_at, CONCAT('/app/users/', u.id) AS route_path FROM app_user u WHERE u.id = #{id} AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.role IN ('USER', 'VERIFIED_SELLER')

SELECT t.id, 'TOPIC' AS document_type, t.name AS title, COALESCE(t.description, '') AS content, '社区话题' AS author_name, NULL AS avatar_url, NULL AS source_url, NULL AS pet_type, NULL AS category, NULL AS trust_level, t.created_at AS published_at, CONCAT('/app/community?topic=', t.id) AS route_path FROM community_topic t WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT source.* FROM () source ORDER BY source.document_type, source.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO search_history (id, user_id, query_text, normalized_query, query_hash, filters_json, result_count, search_count, last_searched_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{queryText}, #{normalizedQuery}, #{queryHash}, #{filtersJson}, #{resultCount}, #{searchCount}, #{lastSearchedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE query_text = VALUES(query_text), normalized_query = VALUES(normalized_query), filters_json = VALUES(filters_json), result_count = VALUES(result_count), search_count = search_count + 1, last_searched_at = VALUES(last_searched_at), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM search_history WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO search_index_job (id, requested_by, index_name, index_version, status, total_count, indexed_count, failed_count, error_message, started_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{requestedBy}, #{indexName}, #{indexVersion}, #{status}, #{totalCount}, #{indexedCount}, #{failedCount}, #{errorMessage}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE search_index_job SET status = 'FAILED', indexed_count = #{indexedCount}, failed_count = #{failedCount}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, updated_at = #{completedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
